title: portabilityrisk_occurrence_portability_v1.tsv
description: Row schema for portabilityrisk_occurrence_portability_v1.tsv. Tab-separated, UTF-8, LF line endings, header row required.

assembly_version.description: Version suffix matters: a re-versioned assembly is a different record.

biosample_accession.description: 6,285 distinct BioSamples across 6,288 assemblies: a few samples have more than one assembly.

bioproject_accession.description: 2,283 projects, but effective count by 1/HHI is 136.9 — the nominal count overstates independence.

organism_harmonized.description: Harmonised, so it may differ in spelling from the raw submission.

replicon_accession.description: 12,811 distinct replicons. Unique only within a versioned assembly.

replicon_molecule_type.description: DOCUMENTATION, not prediction. This is why the location layer has no error rate: 0 unmatched, 0 ambiguous, 0 missing coordinates. It holds only because every genome is closed.

determinant_name.description: A symbol, not a proven phenotype. No MIC or susceptibility data exists here.

gene_family.description: Empty where AMRFinderPlus assigns no family.

drug_class.description: Association as annotated by the database, not measured resistance.

gene_start.description: 1-based inclusive. Part of the primary key.

gene_end.description: 1-based inclusive. Part of the primary key.

strand.description: Not used in any distance or class computation.

location_evidence.description: The whole cohort resolves by direct join; no prediction step exists in this dataset.

portability_class.description: OPERATIONAL, not biological. Class A is not 'immobile' and class C is not 'non-mobilizable' — both are statements about what a marker database returned.

mobility_category.description: Empty for chromosomal rows by construction. 'Predicted' means marker-consistent; no conjugation was performed.

evidence_layer_mobility.description: Empty for all 35,140 chromosomal rows (47.26 %) by construction, not by missing data.

evidence_layer_mge.description: Empty for all 39,209 plasmid rows (52.74 %) by construction, not by missing data. The two mobility/MGE emptiness counts are exactly complementary and sum to 74,349.
